cohort: Pregnant women in England aged 15-49 years
finding: Maternal PCOS was associated with an increased risk of preterm birth and cesarean delivery, but not with low birthweight or stillbirth.
mod_finding: Maternal PCOS was associated with an increased risk of emergency caesarean, elective caesarean and instrumental vaginal delivery compared to spontaneous delivery.
birth_weight: Low birthweight (< 2500 g), high birthweight (> 4000 g)
